package gateways

import (
	"context"

	models "example.test/gwapp/internal/models/gateways"
	"example.test/gwapp/internal/scope"
	queries "example.test/gwapp/internal/storage/queries/gateways"
)

// AuditStore is the authored audit adapter.
type AuditStore struct{ db scope.DB }

func NewAuditStore(db scope.DB) *AuditStore { return &AuditStore{db: db} }

// Append records one event in the verified tenant, attributed to the verified
// subject.
func (s *AuditStore) Append(
	ctx context.Context,
	e scope.Execution,
	in models.AuthEvent,
) error {
	return s.db.Write(ctx, e, func(ctx context.Context, tx scope.Tx) error {
		return queriesOf(tx).AppendAudit(ctx, queries.AppendAuditParams{
			OrgID:   tx.Tenant(),
			ActorID: tx.SubjectID(),
			Type:    "auth." + in.Event,
		})
	})
}
